get.description: Returns the transcript of a campaign video as JSON, or as a subtitle file with `?format=vtt` or `?format=srt`. Reading never starts a transcription, so this endpoint costs nothing and has no side effects. A campaign whose transcript is not ready returns `404`; use the status endpoint to tell why.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: The workspace the campaign belongs to. Retrieve it from `GET /v1/workspaces/identifier`.

parameters.name: campaignId
parameters.description: The campaign whose video transcript you want.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The representation to return. `json` is the default. `vtt` returns a WebVTT file and `srt` a SubRip file, both sent as a download with a `Content-Disposition` header.

200.description: The transcript, in the requested representation.

text/vtt.example:
WEBVTT

1
00:00:00.779 --> 00:00:06.259
Hi there, thanks for taking a look at this.

application/x-subrip.example:
1
00:00:00,779 --> 00:00:06,259
Hi there, thanks for taking a look at this.

400.description: Bad Request — the `format` query parameter is not one of `json`, `vtt` or `srt`, or `workspaceId` or `campaignId` is not a valid Sendspark ID.

401.description: Unauthorized — the API key or secret is missing, invalid or revoked.

404.description: Not Found — the campaign has no transcript ready, does not exist, or belongs to another workspace. A campaign in another workspace is deliberately indistinguishable from one that does not exist; call the status endpoint to tell a missing transcript from a missing campaign.

503.description: Service Unavailable — the transcript exists but could not be read.

get.summary: Get the transcript status of a campaign video
get.description: Reports whether a campaign video has a transcript and whether it is ready to read. It never starts a transcription, so it is safe to poll, and a campaign that never had one returns `none` rather than an error.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: The workspace the campaign belongs to. Retrieve it from `GET /v1/workspaces/identifier`.

parameters.name: campaignId
parameters.description: The campaign whose video transcript you want.

400.description: Bad Request — `workspaceId` or `campaignId` is not a valid Sendspark ID.

401.description: Unauthorized — the API key or secret is missing, invalid or revoked.

404.description: Not Found — the campaign does not exist, or it belongs to another workspace. The two cases are deliberately indistinguishable.

503.description: Service Unavailable — the transcript status could not be read.

post.summary: Create a video and get its upload URL
post.description:
Creates a standard video as the user the API secret belongs to and returns its share link plus `upload.url`, where the video file goes.

1. Call this endpoint.
2. Send the file to `upload.url` with a single HTTP `PUT` of the raw bytes, from a server, before `upload.expiresAt`. Browsers cannot upload to this URL. Accepted files: .mp4 and .mov.
3. Poll `GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/campaigns/{campaignId}/status` about every 10 seconds until `status` is `ready`. `failed` and `expired` are also final.

**Retries:** send an `Idempotency-Key` header. Repeating a request with the same key returns the first response instead of creating a second video. The same key with a different body returns `422`.

**Limits:** each API key user can have 10 videos waiting for their file at a time, and each workspace can create a set number of videos through the API in any 24 hours: 20 on a free trial, 200 on Growth, 500 on Team, 1,500 on Business, and the contracted number on Enterprise. Past either limit, the endpoint returns `429` with a `Retry-After` header. Requests are also limited to 30 per minute per API key on each endpoint; past that, `429` without a `code`.

Errors from this endpoint carry a machine-readable `code`. Authentication and access errors (`401`, a disabled API key, a workspace ID that does not match the API key, a user who is not a member) do not.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: The workspace the API key belongs to. Retrieve it from `GET /v1/workspaces/identifier`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Any unique string up to 255 characters, such as a UUID. A retry with the same key returns the first response instead of creating a second video.

example.title: Welcome to Sendspark
example.message: Here is a quick video I made for you.

200.description: The video was created and is waiting for its file. A repeat with the same `Idempotency-Key` returns this same response.

400.description: Bad Request: `invalid_request` when a field is missing or invalid (the message names the field), or `invalid_workspace` when the workspace ID does not match the API key.

value.message: "ctaButtons[0].url" url must be an http, https, mailto or tel link
title must contain at least one letter or digit

401.description: Unauthorized: the API key or secret is missing, invalid or revoked.

403.description: Forbidden: `video_limit_reached` when the workspace has reached its plan's video limit. A disabled API key also returns `403`, without a `code`.

404.description: Not Found: `member_not_found`, `folder_not_found` or `template_not_found`. A `404` without a `code` means the API key user is not a member of the workspace or the workspace's plan does not include this endpoint.

value.message: Folder not found. Use a folder of this workspace the API key user can see, or omit folderId to use their personal folder.
Template not found. Use a share-page template of this workspace, or omit templateId.

409.description: Conflict: `request_in_progress`. A request with the same `Idempotency-Key` is still running, or another video is being created for the same API key user. Retry in a few seconds.

example.message: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still running. Retry in a few seconds to get its result.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity: `idempotency_key_reused`. The `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different request body.

example.message: This Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body. Use a new key for a new video.

429.description: Too Many Requests: `open_upload_limit` when the API key user already has 10 videos waiting for their file, or `daily_upload_limit` when the workspace has created its daily number of videos through the API. Wait for the number of seconds in `Retry-After`.

value.message: This API key user already has 10 videos waiting for their file. Upload the files you created, or wait for unused uploads to expire, then retry.
This workspace created 200 videos through the API in the last 24 hours, which is its limit. Retry later, or contact support to raise it.

Retry-After.description: How many seconds to wait before retrying.

500.description: Internal Server Error: `create_failed`. Nothing was created, so it is safe to retry.

example.message: The video could not be created. Nothing was created; it is safe to retry.

503.description: Service Unavailable: `upload_service_unavailable`. Nothing was created. Retry shortly.

example.message: The video service is unavailable right now. Nothing was created; retry shortly.

get.summary: Get the status and share link of a video
get.description:
Reports the processing status and share link of a video. `status` is `waiting_for_upload`, `processing`, `ready`, `failed` or `expired`. `ready`, `failed` and `expired` are final, so stop polling there. The share link plays once `status` is `ready`.

Poll about every 10 seconds. The answer can lag a few seconds behind. This endpoint works for any video in a folder the API key user can see. `upload.url` is returned only to the user who created the video.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: The workspace the API key belongs to. Retrieve it from `GET /v1/workspaces/identifier`.

parameters.name: campaignId
parameters.description: The `campaignId` returned when the video was created.

200.description: The current status of the video.

400.description: Bad Request: `invalid_workspace` when the workspace ID does not match the API key. A malformed `workspaceId` or `campaignId` also returns `400`.

example.message: Invalid workspace ID: the API key belongs to another workspace

401.description: Unauthorized: the API key or secret is missing, invalid or revoked.

404.description: Not Found: `video_not_found` when the video does not exist, was deleted, belongs to another workspace or sits in a folder the API key user cannot see. These cases are deliberately indistinguishable. `member_not_found` when the API key user or the workspace was not found.

example.message: Resource not found or invalid access

500.description: Internal Server Error: the video could not be read right now. Retry.

message.example: Resource not found or invalid access
Invalid request payload input / Any error from provider

validationField.example: Show field with errors, Example: contactEmail

validationMessage.example: Show error detail related with field with error, example: Invalid email

validationCode.example: Show error code related with field with error, example: 400

status.example: Current prospect status, Example: saved, billed, errored, processing, uploaded, completed

deletedAt.example: Deleted Date if prospect was deleted, Example: 2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z

valid.example: False if prospect has validation errors

shareUrl.example: Public URL to share the final video, example: https://sendspark.com/share/997f191e81

contactEmail.description: Must be unique for each dynamics videos campaign
Must be unique for each dynamics videos campaign

extractUrlFromEmail.description: If true, sets backgroundUrl based on email domain. If false, removes backgroundUrls matching email domain.

CampaignTranscriptSegmentSchema.description: A block of speech, as the transcription provider divided it.

speaker.description: The speaker the provider attributed the block to.

start.description: Seconds from the start of the video.

end.description: Seconds from the start of the video.

text.example: Hi there, thanks for taking a look at this.

language.description: The language the transcript is stored under.

source.description: Which recording the transcript describes: `master` is the campaign's own video, `prospect` the personalized render made for one recipient.

generatedAt.description: When the transcript was produced. Null for a prospect transcript, which is derived from the master.

text.description: The whole transcript as plain text, one line per segment.
text.example: Hi there, thanks for taking a look at this.

status.description: `none` — no transcript was ever requested. `processing` — one is being produced. `ready` — it can be read. `failed` — generation did not succeed.

label.description: Button text. Plain text, up to 100 characters. HTML tags are refused.

url.description: An http, https, mailto or tel link. Template variables are not supported.

title.description: Letters, digits, spaces, hyphens (-), ampersands (&) and parentheses, up to 45 characters. Apostrophes are removed, any other character becomes a space, and a longer title is cut to fit. The response returns the title as stored.

folderId.description: A folder of the workspace the API key user can see, other than the Requested folder. Defaults to their personal folder. Find it in the address bar when the folder is open in your Sendspark library: the value after `folderId=`.

templateId.description: A share-page template of the workspace, applied before `message` and `ctaButtons`. Find it in the address bar when the template is open in the template editor: the last part, after the final `/`.

message.description: Share-page message. Plain text, up to 2000 characters. HTML tags are refused. Overrides the template message.
message.example: Here is a quick video I made for you.

ctaButtons.description: Up to 10 share-page buttons. Overrides the template buttons. An empty list removes them.

url.description: Send the video file here in a single `PUT` of the raw bytes, from a server. Only the API key user who created the video receives it; for anyone else it is `null`.

expiresAt.description: After this time the URL no longer accepts a file and the video ends as `expired`.

campaignId.description: The video's ID. Use it to poll the status endpoint.

shareId.description: The ID in the share and embed links.

title.description: The title as stored, after cleaning.

shareUrl.description: The video's share page. Uses the workspace's custom domain when one is set.

embedUrl.description: The embeddable player for the video.

status.description: `waiting_for_upload`: send the file to `upload.url` before `upload.expiresAt`. `processing`: the file arrived and is being prepared. `ready`: the share link plays. `failed`: the file could not be processed. `expired`: no file arrived before `upload.expiresAt`. `ready`, `failed` and `expired` are final.

code.description: A stable, machine-readable error code. Branch on this, not on `message`.
